'''Oldksam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Okay, Oldksam can help you. He is hiding out in the Krayt Cult cave. Just give him this flower and he will know that you are from me.''"<br />"''Dried flowers? How romantic.|[[Taibela]] and a bounty hunter|<ref name="SWG:FJ" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Oldksam resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] with his fiancée, [[Taibela]]. They were acquainted with the thugs [[Untas]] and [[Sleash]].<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Untas was indebted to the crime boss [[Faeto]]. When Faeto placed a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] on him, Oldksam, Sleash and Untas went into hiding. Taibela stayed in Mos Eisley, where she was questioned by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. The bounty hunter convinced her to reveal where Oldksam was hiding. The bounty hunter then tracked Oldksam, who was hiding in the [[Krayt Cult Cave]] to elude Faeto. When the bounty hunter told him that the death mark only targeted Untas, Oldksam agreed with giving Sleash's location. The bounty hunter later found Sleash, then Untas, and finally killed the latter.<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oldksam was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Oldksam was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
